newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Campbell Bros keen on more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Bros keen on more acquisitions.

text.p: Industrial products and services provider Campbell Brothers Ltd said on Wednesday it was keen on making further acquisitions, particularly in its core business areas of soap, chemicals and laboratory services.

"The medium-term prospects look very good. We continue to grow Australian Laboratory Services, particularly globally while improving profitability of our chemicals business and other improvements through acquisition," managing director Bruce Brown told a brokers' breakfast meeting.
Brown said he was pleased with the growing opportunities for the group's minerals analysis subsidiary with further expansion seen in Africa, North America, China and Russia.
"It (minerals analysis) is very much a global business," Brown said.
Last month, Campbell Brothers reported a net profit jump to a record A$7.44 million for the year ending March 31 from A$4.31 million the previous year.
Accompanying the results was a one-for-four ordinary share issue at A$3.60 a share, aimed at raising about A$21 million to repay debt following a series of acquisitions in the past year.
